page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: page number and running head at top, one column of glossary entries (Greek headwords with Latin and Hebrew glosses), catchword and signature none. Right page: narrow marginal notes in the right margin of the scan (partly cut off by the binding); no main column beyond them.

main_text.p: ᾿Ατροφία ὡς ἡ nomen mul. Hebr. pistrix.
᾿Αρφ ὁ nomen Gentile. q.d. defertum incolens.
᾿Αρεβία ὡς ἡ nomen reg. Heb. erémus, defertum.
᾿Αρὰμ ὁ est nomen viri ἀνλίζῳ, Hebr. altus, fublimis, Luc. 3. 33.
᾿Αρέτας ὡ ὁ Aretas æ, nomen viri, Gr. virtuti deditus.
᾿Αρεὶ πάγῳ ὁ nomen loci, nempe curia Atheniensis, Gr. Martius collis.
᾿Αρεμαθαῖα ὡς ἡ nomen urbis, Hebr. leo mortuus.
᾿Αρίστερχῳ ὁ nomen viri, Græce optimus princeps.
᾿Αρίστόλῳ ὁ nomen viri, Gr. optimus confiliarius.
᾿Αρμαγεδδὼν ἡ nomen Hebr. compositum ex chérem anáthema, & gedud turma. q.d. exercitus maledictus.
᾿Αρτεμᾶς ὦ ὁ Artemas est nomen viri, Gr. incolumis.
᾿Αρφαξὰδ ὁ nomen viri ἀνλίζῳ, Hebr. fanans vastationem.
᾿Αρχέλαος ὡ ὁ Archelaus nomen viri, Gr. princeps populi.
᾿Αρχιπτῷ ὡ ὁ nomen viri, Græce magister equorum.

page.notes: Right page: the marginal column is cut off by the binding and very faint; the legible fragments (e.g. "Rom. 11.4", "Syriac", "Gracus, 1.Cor.", "patris", "absinthium") are marginal notes that I could only partly read, so they are not transcribed in full. Greek headwords are transcribed approximately and should be checked against the scan.
